name: away-window-fully-away
description: Away days with the whole watering window unavailable and the pre-leave option switched off: the plant is watered on the first available day after, and its outlook is decay.
why: 02a 5.4: plan on available days only and flag the plant. Fern (keep_moist, I=4, last 2026-10-31) has window 11-03 to 11-04; 11-03 to 11-08 are unavailable; first available day is 11-09, a 9-day gap against a band high of 4. PROVISIONAL outlook rule: past the band by more than 1.5 x the dry tolerance (default ceil(I/2) = 2) is decay. Hand-computed.
